name: high_priest_of_winter
description: a High Priest of Winter, an old priest with a long flowing white beard and white hair, a tall crown of blue ice crystals, a thick white fur cloak and mantle, blue-and-white robes with snowflake patterns down the front panel, pale gloves, and an ice staff topped with a glowing star-shaped ice crystal in his LEFT hand
hands: the ice staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is held against his chest as an empty fist

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the long white beard swinging, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the ice staff)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the ice staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up with the ice staff, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the white beard hanging, the ice staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the ice staff slanting down with its star-crystal head resting on the ground, the right arm hanging, the white fur cloak pooled around him
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the ice staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the ice crown still on his head; the ice staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the white fur cloak spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white beard and the fur cloak settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the ice staff on the ground beside him, its crystal dimmed
